<defs>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg: #0b0f14;
            --panel: #121820;
            --stroke: #a7b3c1;
            --muted: #6d7b8a;
            --accent: #5ec8ff;
            --ok: #28c76f;
            --warn: #f1c40f;
            --alarm: #ff5b5b;
            --text: #e6eef7;
        }

        .bg {
            fill: var(--bg);
        }

        .panel {
            fill: var(--panel);
            stroke: #1e2a36;
            stroke-width: 1.5;
        }

        .outline {
            stroke: var(--stroke);
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2;
        }

        .thin {
            stroke-width: 1.2;
        }

        .muted {
            stroke: var(--muted);
            fill: none;
        }

        .label {
            fill: var(--text);
            font-family: system-ui, Arial, sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .small {
            font-size: 12px;
            fill: #cfd8e3;
        }

        .title {
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: .5px;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .led {
            stroke: #0a0a0a;
            stroke-width: 1;
        }

        .led.ok {
            fill: var(--ok);
        }

        .led.warn {
            fill: var(--warn);
        }

        .led.alarm {
            fill: var(--alarm);
        }

        .led.off {
            fill: #2b343f;
        }

        .busbar {
            stroke: var(--stroke);
            stroke-width: 4;
        }

        .breaker {
            stroke: var(--stroke);
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 3;
        }

        .breaker.open line.blade {
            transform-origin: center;
            transform: rotate(-35deg);
        }

        .breaker.closed line.blade {
            transform-origin: center;
            transform: rotate(0deg);
        }

        .coil {
            stroke: var(--stroke);
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2;
        }

        .coil path {
            fill: none;
        }

        .gauge-scale {
            stroke: #3a4654;
            stroke-width: 2;
        }

        .gauge-needle {
            stroke: var(--accent);
            stroke-width: 3;
        }

        .bar-bg {
            fill: #1a2430;
            stroke: #2a3543;
        }

        .bar-val {
            fill: var(--accent);
        }

        .anno {
            fill: #9fb3c8;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        /* Handy states (toggle these in SCADA) */
        [data-state="ok"] .status-dot {
            fill: var(--ok);
        }

        [data-state="warn"] .status-dot {
            fill: var(--warn);
        }

        [data-state="alarm"] .status-dot {
            fill: var(--alarm);
        }
    </style>

</defs>
